outcome.answer: Highly ambiguous token distributions are hard because the model has to choose among many plausible continuations, and the supplied papers do not directly explain this token-level training difficulty. The closest evidence is that retrieval and generation can become unreliable when evidence is sparse or conflicting: stronger retrieval can still lead to confident hallucinations if relevant documents are absent [1], and complex, repetitive document settings with distractors make exhaustive retrieval difficult [8].
